reconstructed_captions.25: He picks up a pair of wire strippers to demonstrate.
reconstructed_captions.26: He places a wire into the strippers and squeezes to cut the insulation.
reconstructed_captions.27: He pulls the end of the insulation off, exposing the copper wire.
reconstructed_captions.28: He repeats the process on a second wire to prepare for a connection.
reconstructed_captions.29: He aligns the two stripped ends of the wires together.
reconstructed_captions.30: He uses his fingers to twist the two bare copper wires together.
